mapper.sql: WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND project_id=#{projectId} AND (window_id=#{windowId} OR assigned_window_id=#{windowId}) AND application_status=#{status} AND requester_id=#{requesterId} AND (application_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR subsystem_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR subsystem_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM rel_release_application ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM rel_release_application WHERE application_code=#{code} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
SELECT FROM rel_release_application WHERE application_code=#{code} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM rel_release_application WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
SELECT tenant_id FROM rel_release_application WHERE application_code=#{code} AND deleted=0
SELECT application_code FROM rel_release_application WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND application_code LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix},'%') ORDER BY application_code DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE rel_release_application SET emergency=#{emergency},window_id=#{windowId},subsystem_id=#{subsystemId},subsystem_code=#{subsystemCode},subsystem_name=#{subsystemName},version_type=#{versionType},characteristic=#{characteristic},workflow_code=#{workflowCode},emergency_description=#{emergencyDescription},urgent_reason=#{urgentReason},description=#{description},updated_by=#{updatedBy},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND row_version=#{expectedVersion}
UPDATE rel_application_delivery SET active=0 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND active=1
UPDATE rel_application_requirement SET active=0 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND active=1

UPDATE rel_release_application SET application_status=#{toStatus},updated_by=#{operatorId},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND application_status=#{fromStatus} AND row_version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT a.id FROM rel_release_application a JOIN rel_application_delivery d ON d.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND d.application_id=a.id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.window_id=#{windowId} AND a.deleted=0 AND a.application_status <> 'CANCELLED' AND d.active=1 AND d.item_key IN #{item} AND a.id <> #{excludedId} ORDER BY a.id

SELECT DISTINCT r.related_application_id FROM rel_application_relation r JOIN rel_application_delivery current_item ON current_item.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND current_item.application_id=r.application_id AND current_item.active=1 AND current_item.item_key=r.item_key JOIN rel_release_application related ON related.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND related.id=r.related_application_id AND related.deleted=0 WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.application_id=#{applicationId} AND r.relation_type='ADDITIONAL' AND r.related_application_id <> r.application_id ORDER BY r.related_application_id

SELECT id,delivery_unit_id,delivery_unit_code,delivery_unit_name,artifact_type,artifact_version,item_type,file_path,item_key FROM rel_application_delivery WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND active=1 ORDER BY id
SELECT requirement_code FROM rel_application_requirement WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND active=1 ORDER BY id
